assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The denied service is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The appeal is for episode ep-05058
The denial cites that precertification was not obtained before services were rendered
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope
The symptoms raise concern for intermittent arrhythmia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The diagnosis code Z86.73 corresponds to personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances
The documentation supports the medical necessity of the monitoring
